name: portfolio
description: Lucas Gutknecht's professional portfolio — Angular + TypeScript Lambda, served through CloudFront.

scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../api && npm install && cd ../infra && npm install
scripts.typecheck: cd api && npm run typecheck && cd ../infra && npm run typecheck
scripts.synth: npm run build && cd infra && npm run synth
scripts.diff: npm run build && cd infra && npm run diff
scripts.deploy: npm run build && cd infra && npm run deploy
